title: Exemptions.
bodyText: This chapter shall not apply to print multiples which do not purport to be signed, numbered, approved by the artist, or to comprise a limited edition.
bodyHtml: [§481F-2]  Exemptions.  This chapter shall not apply to print multiples which do not purport to be signed, numbered, approved by the artist, or to comprise a limited edition. [L 1986, c 194, pt of §2]
